requirement_text: The system shall create a manifest by specifying an origin location and a trailer or bay number.
The system shall assign each manifest a unique identifier upon creation.
The system shall automatically populate a new manifest with commonly used items for that location, initialized at zero quantity.
The system shall timestamp every manifest state change to maintain a history.
The system shall allow adding an item and quantity to a manifest in the Building state.
The system shall allow removing an item from a manifest in the Building state.
The system shall transition a manifest from Building to Ready when marked ready by a manager.
The system shall revert a manifest from Ready to Building state if its quantity is edited.
The system shall require a driver to add or confirm a destination before accepting a Ready manifest.
The system shall allow a receiver to update quantities and mark an Accepted manifest as Received.
The system shall prevent editing of a manifest once it is in the Received state.
The system shall provide search-as-you-type filtering for locations, trailers, and item types.
The system shall display a user-friendly retry message instead of a generic error when network access is unavailable.
The system shall process rapid, repeated increment-button clicks correctly without UI lag.
